IMPACT DUCHENNE primary completion 2029-01 (NCT07160634, book trials table)
column12: JUDGEMENT. Registrational path: accelerated approval on microdystrophin expression from INSPIRE DUCHENNE, with IMPACT DUCHENNE (FDA-aligned in a February 2026 Type C meeting: ambulant 7 to <12, TTR velocity at 18 months) as the confirmatory trial; first participant dosed April 2026. A BLA filed in 2027 after the late-Q4 2026 meeting, with Fast Track and Rare Pediatric Disease designations, gives an action date in late 2027 or 2028, so 2028 is the first model year; the ramp starts at 8.5% of peak in year 0, which absorbs a part year. Case for later: the FDA meeting has already slipped from the first half of 2026 (FY2025 10-K) to late Q4 2026, and Solid has not stated a BLA date. If the FDA wants IMPACT data, the 18-month endpoint reads out after 2029-01 and launch moves to about 2030 to 2031. Solid's own risk factors cite 'increased scrutiny of accelerated approval pathways'. Case for earlier: none; no BLA can be filed before the FDA meeting

column12: JUDGEMENT on the tier: each 'low single digit' is read at its 1% floor, as the book reads that wording (Adimanebart IV and verified NTLA-2002 seeds), so Solid pays 2% of sales. House netting of a royalty paid, (margin - royalty) / margin: (0.1363 - 0.02) / 0.1363 = 0.853265. Re-strike as (m - 0.02) / m if Solid's cost block changes. Case for lower: at 2% each (4% in all) the share is 0.7065, and at 3% each 0.5598; an AAV's cost of goods is likely above Alnylam's 18.2%, which thins the margin and the share. Case for higher: the licensed US patents expire 2028 to 2036 (10-K patents section), so the royalties may lapse early in the forecast. Solid owns SGT-003 and its POLARIS-101 capsid ('our rationally designed, proprietary capsid used in SGT-003', 10-K) and has no commercial partner. No payable to Ultragenyx is filed: the 2020 Ultragenyx collaboration appears only as a share sale (521,719 shares) and a $375k payment Solid made to the University of Washington on signing it. Other licences named as exhibits (Harvard 2016 and 2017, Michigan 2016, Life Technologies cell line 2016) are filed without terms; the 10-K says such agreements may carry royalties, but states none on SGT-003. Not in this field: academic milestones of about $3.4mm (Washington) and $1.9mm (Missouri), and minimum annual royalties.

column12: Carried by the book. The engine filters it by eligible_pct: 367 x 0.1323 = 48.6 a year. That understates the real inflow to an ambulatory 4-and-over pool, which every surviving boy enters at age 4 (about 196 a year after the antibody and mutation filters); see untreated_carryover_pct

column11: Three filters. (1) Ambulatory, aged 4 and over: 0.2478. Median age at loss of ambulation 13 years on corticosteroids and 10 years without (Koeks Z et al., J Neuromuscul Dis 2017;4:293, doi:10.3233/JND-170280, PMID 29125504, TREAT-NMD, 5,345 patients), weighted by US steroid initiation of 68.9% (MD STARnet, Thomas S et al., J Child Neurol 2025, PMID 40879420, as the verified deramiocel seed cites): 0.689 x (13 - 4) + 0.311 x (10 - 4) = 8.07 ambulatory years from age 4, x 367.17 a year = 2,962 boys, / 11,952 = 0.2478. (2) Seronegative to the capsid: 0.64. AAV-SLB101 is AAV9 with a 7-amino-acid insertion (trade coverage found by search, CGTlive, cgtlive.com/view/solid-next-generation-dmd-gene-therapy-cleared-first-in-human-trial); AAV9 neutralising antibodies in 36% of 101 US males with DMD (Verma S et al., Hum Gene Ther 2023;34:430, doi:10.1089/hum.2022.081, PMID 36324212). Both trials require participants 'negative for AAV antibodies'. (3) Not carrying an excluded deletion: at most 0.834. IMPACT DUCHENNE excludes 'any deletion variant or variant predicted not to express exons 1 to 11, exons 42 to 45, or exons 57 to 69' (NCT07160634 listing, clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07160634); INSPIRE excludes deletions in exons 1-11 or 42-45 (CGTlive). In the TREAT-NMD global database (Bladen CL et al., Hum Mutat 2015;36, doi:10.1002/humu.22758, PMID 25604253, 7,149 mutations, Table 2), deletions amenable to skipping exon 43 (7.5% of mutations), exon 44 (7.1%) and exon 8 (2.0%) each lie wholly in an excluded region, since a deletion adjacent to exon 43 includes exon 42 or 44, one adjacent to exon 44 includes 43 or 45, and one adjacent to exon 8 includes 7 or 9: 1 - 0.166 = 0.834. Product 0.2478 x 0.64 x 0.834 = 0.1323
column12: JUDGEMENT on the label: ambulatory, 4 and over, the population of Elevidys's current label (ambulatory patients 4 years and older after the non-ambulatory population was removed in November 2025, Sarepta 10-Q 0001193125-26-335003), the FDA's standing view of where an AAV microdystrophin's benefit-risk holds. The trials are narrower: INSPIRE enrolled ambulatory boys 4 to 11 weighing 50 kg or less (10 m walk/run under 30 s), IMPACT ambulant 7 to <12; a label capped at 11 would remove the ambulatory boys aged 12 and over and lower this value. Filter (1) treats the median age at loss of ambulation as the mean and counts every boy aged 4 as diagnosed. Filter (2) is a JUDGEMENT to use the parent capsid; Verma found higher seroprevalence in ambulatory than non-ambulatory boys, and Solid's assay and threshold are not public, so 0.64 may overstate. The rh74 comparison is 86.1% seronegative by total binding antibody below 1:400 (Goedeker NL et al., Ther Adv Neurol Disord 2023, PMID 36710722). Filter (3) is a ceiling: deletions starting at exon 45 that are amenable to skipping exons 51, 53 or 55 (for example 45-50, 45-52, 45-54), deletions in exons 57 to 69 and proximal deletions not adjacent to exon 8 are also excluded but not counted, so the true share is lower, if the label carries the trial's exclusions at all (Elevidys's label kept only an exon 8 and/or 9 contraindication from its trials' wider exclusions). Weight, liver function and prior gene therapy are not applied. Pool: 11,952 x 0.1323 = 1,581 US boys. Second read: INSPIRE's eligible age range is now 0 to <12 in three cohorts (4 to <7, dosing weight up to 27.8 kg; 7 to <12, up to 39.7 kg; 0 to <3, up to 17.0 kg), 23 dosed at ages 1 to 10 by 31 October 2025 (Solid corporate presentation, 8-K 0001193125-25-262795 exhibit 99.2). IMPACT also requires a stable daily prednisone or deflazacort regimen for at least 12 weeks and walking without an assistive device (Parent Project MD trial listing). A label on INSPIRE's range, ambulatory 4 to <12, gives 0.689 x 8 + 0.311 x 6 = 7.378 years, 0.2267 x 0.64 x 0.834 = 0.1210; one on IMPACT's 7 to <12 gives 0.0718

column11: Elevidys, the incumbent AAV microdystrophin, under its current ambulatory-only boxed-warning label. Net revenue $102.0mm Q1 2026 and $98.1mm Q2 2026, $200,090k for H1 (Sarepta 10-Q 0001193125-26-335003; 8-K 0001193125-26-208966): x 2 / $2.5152mm net (3.2 x (1 - 0.214), gross_to_net above) = 159.1 patient-equivalents a year. Its eligible pool: 11,952 x 0.2478 (ambulatory 4+) x 0.861 (AAVrh74-seronegative below 1:400, Goedeker, PMID 36710722) = 2,550. Already treated: 2023-2025 net revenue $200,356k + $820,791k + $898,731k (FY2025 10-K 0001193125-26-084144, Note 7) / $2.5152mm = 763 patient-equivalents, 750 of 900 ambulatory (Sarepta, June 2025 safety update and call: more than 900 dosed, 150 non-ambulatory, via search) = 636. Untreated 2,550 - 636 = 1,914, plus 78.3 of engine inflow (367 x 0.2478 x 0.861): 159.1 / 1,992 = 0.0799 a year. SGT-003 at 0.5x: 0.0399
column12: JUDGEMENT: 0.5x Elevidys's current capture. Two parts: (1) by 2028 Elevidys will have treated about 954 ambulatory boys (636 + 2 x 159.1), 37% of the shared pool at its current rate, and a boy treated with one AAV gene therapy is excluded from the other (INSPIRE excludes prior gene transfer), while the engine starts SGT-003's pool untreated, so about 0.63 carries that depletion, which fades as treated cohorts age out; (2) about 0.8 for sharing the flow with Elevidys and, from 2027-28, RGX-202. How the 2025 safety events bear on this: safety events announced in March and June 2025 (fatal acute liver failure in non-ambulatory patients) led to a halt of non-ambulatory shipments, an FDA-requested US pause from 22 July 2025, resumption for ambulatory patients on 31 July, and in November 2025 a boxed warning for acute liver injury and failure with non-ambulatory patients removed from the indication (Sarepta 10-Q 0001193125-26-335003). Quarterly Elevidys revenue fell from $375.0mm in Q1 2025 to $98.1mm in Q2 2026, and Sarepta attributes the fall to 'changes in demand following the safety events that occurred in 2025 and subsequent label update'. The anchor therefore reflects both the narrower label and depressed demand. Case for higher: the Q1 2025 rate, 596 patient-equivalents a year at $2.5152mm, was 3.7 times today's, so latent demand exists that a better-tolerated product (steroid-only regimen; Solid reports two treatment-related serious adverse events in 53 dosed, 10-Q 0001193125-26-337935) could recover. Case for lower: Elevidys has three-year EMBARK data and incumbency, Sarepta is testing sirolimus to reopen non-ambulatory dosing, a third gene therapy is due, and Solid launches with no commercial infrastructure. Engine check (pool 1,581, inflow 48.6, retention 0.9702, curve below): 5.5 patients in 2028, 28.7 in 2030, peak 56.8 in 2033 ($142.8mm US at $2.5152mm net), 51.9 in 2037
